messages:
Nina K: Quick sync 1:30 UTC change window tonight for `ff:dynamic-encoder` + deploy v4. Plan: region-by-region soft-cutover (EU -> NA -> APAC). Ramp pattern per region: 3% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%. Soak: 8m per step.

Sam R: Are we pinning v3 fallback for APAC until APAC hits 60%? last time APAC flipped under load.

Nina K: Yes pin v3 in APAC until it reaches 60%. For EU/NA we unpin at 15% after soak. If any gate trips we rollback to pinned versions.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Nina K at 2026-03-22T21:30:00Z. Canary allocation: eu-west-3 (3%). Will post health-checks.

Alex P: Telemetry gates: request_error_rate (5m), p95_latency (5m), 99th_token_latency (10m). Circuit rule: if error_rate > 1.0% OR p95 > baseline + 150ms for 2 consecutive windows, set region pct to 0 and re-pin. Auto-notify #eng-oncall.

Sam R: CLI runbook snippets:
```
# start EU 3%
/ff toggle dynamic-encoder --region eu --pct 3 --exclude internal_*
# bump to 15%
/ff toggle dynamic-encoder --region eu --pct 15
# emergency disable and pin v3
/ff toggle dynamic-encoder --pct 0 --pin v3 --reason "auto/ops rollback"
```

Nina K: Pacing tweak: set NA soak at 20m at the 15% step. APAC keep 8m until 60% then monitor 30m before global.

oncall-bot: Alerting configured: page oncall and DM lead if auto-rollback happens. Slack threshold: error_rate > 1.0%.

Alex P: Note: exclude warmup traffic (cohort `staging_*`) from cohorts. Also watch token-cost-rate; if it rises >12% hold ramp and investigate.

Sam R: Add post-rollout check: after global 100% keep 60m watch for tail regressions; if 99th_token_latency regress > 20% file a postmortem and roll back.

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary EU at 3%. Health-checks scheduled at +5m and +8m. Posting status here.

Nina K: Oncall please be ready for manual rollback window 21:38-22:30 UTC. Ping me directly for expedited pin/unpin.

(End of thread)
